scope: A successful installation restores the maximized ready window. Both edition previews were approved after exercising completion from a minimized wizard in a disposable KDE neon session.

checks.command: Disposable KDE neon Plasma VM, simulated successful completion after minimizing the wizard with the fullscreen apply overlay visible. Tahoe and Golden Gate both reported done, maximized, active and no remaining overlay.

coverage_limits: Window behavior at successful completion was exercised using representative installer events.
